Request correlation uses a safe context-variable extractor and `request_id` formatter. Configuration logs expose only a debug summary. All six logging tests and four health-log tests pass.

Scheduler and billing suites pass together (31 tests), focused Ruff checks pass, and `git diff --check` is clean. The scheduler changes remain uncommitted.

Added `tests/test_currency_rounding.py` covering positive/negative half-cent values, zero and small values, default behavior, scales 0–5, invalid negative scale, mixed integer/string/Decimal inputs, and a high-magnitude boundary. Six focused tests pass, `billing/currency.py` reaches 91% line coverage, and Ruff passes. A full run now reports 184 passed and 2 skipped with no failures.
